Full_Text_Official: Maintain, enhance or restore integrity, connectivity and resilience of all ecosystems; halt human-induced extinction of known threatened species and reduce extinction rate and risk tenfold by 2050; maintain genetic diversity of wild and domesticated species.

Short_Title: Sustainable use & nature’s contributions to people
Full_Text_Official: Biodiversity sustainably used and managed and nature’s contributions to people valued, maintained and enhanced, with those in decline restored, supporting sustainable development for present and future generations by 2050.

Monetary and non-monetary benefits from the use of genetic resources, digital sequence information and associated traditional knowledge shared fairly and equitably, including with indigenous peoples and local communities.

Adequate finance, capacity-building, technical and scientific cooperation and technology transfer secured and equitably accessible to all Parties, progressively closing the US$700 billion/year biodiversity finance gap.

Short_Title: Spatial planning to retain high-biodiversity areas
Full_Text_Official: Ensure all areas are under participatory, integrated, biodiversity-inclusive spatial planning, bringing the loss of areas of high biodiversity importance close to zero by 2030.
Ensure at least 30% of degraded terrestrial, inland water, coastal and marine ecosystems are under effective restoration by 2030.

Short_Title: Conserve 30% of land, water and sea (30x30)
Full_Text_Official: Conserve and manage at least 30% of terrestrial, inland water, coastal and marine areas through protected areas and OECMs by 2030.

Short_Title: Halt species extinction & conserve genetic diversity
Full_Text_Official: Halt human-induced extinction of known threatened species, recover and conserve species, maintain genetic diversity and manage human-wildlife conflict.

Short_Title: Sustainable, safe and legal use of wild species
Full_Text_Official: Ensure use, harvesting and trade of wild species is sustainable, safe and legal, preventing overexploitation and reducing pathogen spillover risk.

Short_Title: Reduce invasive alien species introduction by 50%
Full_Text_Official: Reduce the rates of introduction and establishment of invasive alien species by at least 50% and minimise their impacts by 2030.

Short_Title: Reduce pollution risks to non-harmful levels
Full_Text_Official: Reduce pollution risks (excess nutrients, pesticides, plastics) to levels not harmful to biodiversity and ecosystem functions by 2030.

Short_Title: Minimise climate change impacts & build resilience
Full_Text_Official: Minimise the impact of climate change and ocean acidification on biodiversity and increase resilience through mitigation, adaptation and nature-based solutions.

Short_Title: Sustainable management & use of wild species
Full_Text_Official: Ensure the management and use of wild species are sustainable, providing social, economic and environmental benefits, especially for vulnerable people.
Ensure areas under agriculture, aquaculture, fisheries and forestry are managed sustainably, including through biodiversity-friendly practices.
Restore, maintain and enhance nature’s contributions to people, including regulation of air, water and climate, soil health, pollination and disease risk.
Significantly increase the area, quality, connectivity and access to green and blue spaces in urban and densely populated areas.

Short_Title: Fair sharing of benefits from genetic resources & DSI
Full_Text_Official: Take measures to ensure the fair and equitable sharing of benefits from genetic resources, digital sequence information and traditional knowledge.
Integrate biodiversity and its multiple values into policies, regulations, planning, development and poverty-reduction processes across all sectors.

Short_Title: Business assessment & disclosure of biodiversity impacts
Full_Text_Official: Encourage and enable business to monitor, assess and transparently disclose biodiversity-related risks, dependencies and impacts and reduce negative impacts.

Short_Title: Enable sustainable consumption & halve food waste
Full_Text_Official: Enable sustainable consumption choices, reduce the global footprint of consumption and halve global food waste by 2030.
Establish, strengthen and implement biosafety measures and the handling of biotechnology and distribution of its benefits.
Identify and reform or eliminate incentives harmful to biodiversity by at least US$500 billion/year, and scale up positive incentives.
Substantially and progressively increase finance for biodiversity from all sources to at least US$200 billion/year by 2030.
Strengthen capacity-building, access to and transfer of technology and scientific and technical cooperation to meet the needs of implementation.
Ensure the best available data, information and knowledge are accessible to decision-makers, practitioners and the public to guide effective governance.

Short_Title: Ensure participation & rights of IPLCs, women, youth
Full_Text_Official: Ensure full, equitable and effective participation in decision-making and access to justice and information by indigenous peoples, local communities, women and youth.
Ensure gender equality in implementation through a gender-responsive approach where all women and girls have equal opportunity to contribute.
